result.topic_en: Derivation of a formula for the measure of the lateral (geodesic) curvature of the curve on a surface along which θ is constant, expressed through the quantities P, Q, R (first fundamental form coefficients).
result.transcription:

für das Maass der Seitenkr. der Linie für die $\theta$ constant ist

$aa+bb+cc = ss$
$s\xi = a$
$s\eta = b$
$s\zeta = c$
$\frac{\partial a}{\partial t} = a'$

$aa'+bb'+cc' = ss'$

$\sigma s\xi' + \xi s' = a'$
$\sigma s\eta' + \eta s' = b'$
$\sigma s\zeta' + \zeta s' = c'$

$\eta c' - \zeta b' = \sigma s\xi''$
$\zeta a' - \xi c' = \sigma s\eta''$
$\xi b' - \eta a' = \sigma s\zeta''$

$Y\zeta - Z\eta = \frac{(aa+bb+cc)\alpha - a(a\alpha+b\beta+c\gamma)}{\sigma s}$

$aa+bb+cc = P$
$a\alpha+b\beta+c\gamma = Q$
$\alpha\alpha+\beta\beta+\gamma\gamma = R$
$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial t} = a'\alpha+b'\beta+c'\gamma + \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\partial P}{\partial u}$

$([-P\alpha-Qa-])a'$ $= \sigma\sigma sss \cdot \psi$
$P(\alpha a'+\beta b'+\gamma c')$
$- Q(aa'+bb'+cc')$

$= \sigma s^3$. Maass der Seitkr.

$\left(P(Q'-\frac{1}{2}P'') - \frac{1}{2}QP'\right)\partial t = \sigma.ss.\ \partial$ Seitenkr.
$\sigma\sigma = PR - QQ$
$ss = P$

$\partial$ Seitenkr. $= \frac{(PQ'-\frac{1}{2}PP''-\frac{1}{2}QP')\,dt}{\sqrt{(PR-QQ)}.P}$

$[-(Pt't'+2Qt'\theta'+R\theta'\theta')\sqrt{PR-QQ}-]\frac{\partial f}{du} = (t'\theta''-\theta't'')(PR-QQ)$
$+\frac{1}{2}(Pt'+Q\theta')(-P''t't'+2Q't't'+2R't'\theta'+R''\theta'\theta')$
$-\frac{1}{2}(Qt'+R\theta')(P't't'+2P''t'\theta'+2Q''\theta'\theta'-R'\theta'\theta')$
